segments.text: How much are the parts inside an iPhone really worth?
Counterpoint Research estimated the parts of an iPhone 17 Pro Max

segments.say: at about four hundred and ten dollars.

segments.text: So where does the rest go?
those very nice wooden tables in the Apple Store...
But this year, memory prices exploded.
TrendForce estimates the 18 Pro's parts cost about 38 percent more.
segments.say: Trend Force estimates the 18 Pro's parts cost about thirty-eight percent more.
